7.0. OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1There is a defined process for acquisition of medical supplies and consumables.

7.2 Medical supplies and consumables are used in a safe manner, where appropriate.

7.3 Medical supplies and consumables are stored in a clean, safe and secure environment and incorporating manufacturer’s recommendation(s).

7.4 Sound inventory control practices guide storage of medical supplies and consumables.

8.0 PROCEDURES:-

8.1 Refer to procurement from manual

8.2 Refer to storage from manual

8.3 Refer to storage from manual, and medicines under pharmacy should be maintained as per updated stock register (manual or digital) indicating batch number, expiry date, and quantity. Follow First Expiry First Out (FEFO) and First In First Out (FIFO) principles for issuing medicines. Conduct periodic physical stock verification to reconcile actual vs. recorded stock. Record and manage near-expiry and expired medicines separately, with proper disposal as per AYUSH / Pollution Control Board norms. Ensure environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, cleanliness) are maintained as per drug storage requirements.

8.4 For sound inventory control practices hospital will follow FIFO and ABC analysis
